verdict.rationale: Workable documents a REST API that it says gives 'full control over your data,' with read endpoints for jobs, candidates, offers, events, requisitions and stages that return JSON. A user could script a full extraction, but there is no documented one-click bulk export or offboarding export. Leaving therefore depends on building your own API-based tooling. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export feature, open-format (CSV/JSON) bulk download, explicit coverage guarantees (e.g. attachments, resumes, notes), and independent or hands-on confirmation that a complete export works.
